about: Product-specific VST3 component floats, measured from public host APIs. Values are stored VST3 plain values, which need not equal displayed physical units. Component and controller envelopes, unknown float slots and private tails are retained.

layers: stored float32 controls and opaque tail

parameters/Mode.about: VST3 parameter 0. Host display: 0 = Single Vocal; 0 = Single Vocal; 1 = Allround; 1 = Allround; 1 = Allround.

parameters/Threshold.about: VST3 parameter 1. Host display: 0 = -INF dB; 0.25 = -45.00 dB; 0.5 = -30.00 dB; 0.75 = -15.00 dB; 1 = 0.00 dB.

parameters/Range.about: VST3 parameter 2. Host display: 0 = 0.00 dB; 6 = 6.00 dB; 12 = 12.00 dB; 18 = 18.00 dB; 24 = 24.00 dB.

parameters/Band Processing.about: VST3 parameter 3. Host display: 0 = Wide Band; 0 = Wide Band; 1 = Split Band; 1 = Split Band; 1 = Split Band.

parameters/Stereo Link.about: VST3 parameter 4. Host display: 0 = 0%; 0.25 = 50%; 0.5 = 100%; 0.75 = 100%, 50% Mid-only; 1 = 100%, 100% Mid-only.

parameters/Stereo Link Mode.about: VST3 parameter 5. Host display: 0 = Mid; 0 = Mid; 1 = Side; 1 = Side; 1 = Side.

parameters/Lookahead Enabled.about: VST3 parameter 7. Host display: 0 = Disabled; 0 = Disabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled.

parameters/Audition Triggering.about: VST3 parameter 8. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Side Chain Input Signal.about: VST3 parameter 9. Host display: 0 = Normal input; 0 = Normal input; 1 = External; 1 = External; 1 = External.

parameters/Audition Side Chain.about: VST3 parameter 12. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Midi State.about: VST3 parameter 13. Host display: 0 = Enabled; 0 = Enabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled.

parameters/Input Level.about: VST3 parameter 15. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Output Level.about: VST3 parameter 17. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Bypass.about: VST3 parameter 19. Host display: 0 = Not Bypassed; 0 = Not Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed.
